title: Line2D with gradient doesn't use the correct color for the first and last points
body:
### Tested versions

4.5.1.rc1

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.rc1.mono - Linux Mint 21.3 (Virginia) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6800 (RADV NAVI21) - AMD Ryzen 5 7600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 30.42 GiB memory

### Issue description

I'm aware of #50076 and how gradient colors are interpolated. This is a separate issue: that the first and last points in the Line2D seem to use the exact colors of the first and last colors of the gradient. This is a problem because the first and last gradient offsets could be outside of the 0 to 1 range, leading to a different color being at the 0 and 1 positions in the gradient.

The below video shows a Line2D with a gradient that has its first offset below 0 and last offset above 1. All the points in the Line2D show the correct color besides the first and last points, which are always pure red. Compare the gradient preview to the Line2D.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f8827be7-ac20-4698-8354-81c2e7264620

### Steps to reproduce

Add a gradient to a Line2D. The gradient should have at least 3 colors. The first and last gradient offset should be below 0 and above 1.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[line-2d-with-gradient-does-not-use-the-correct-color-at-the-first-and-last-points.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22758037/line-2d-with-gradient-does-not-use-the-correct-color-at-the-first-and-last-points.zip)
